idea-plugin.name: CMS-0057 API Gate
idea-plugin.description:
14 rules read a FHIR CapabilityStatement against CMS-0057-F. A 2021 payer statement returned 6 blocking gaps - three of the four APIs missing - and 107 days left to 1 January 2027.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CMS-0057 API Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cms-0057-api-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cms-0057-api-gate

action.text: CMS-0057 API Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run CMS-0057 API Gate on the file in the editor
